title: skillguard configuration (.skillguard.yml)
description: Schema version 1 of the skillguard configuration file. Unknown fields are rejected by the parser (fail closed).

version.description: Configuration schema version. This build supports exactly 1.

fail_on.description: Findings at or above this severity make the exit code 1. 'none' disables the findings-based exit code.

platforms.description: Platforms to scan. Omit for all platforms; when present the list must not be empty.

include.description: Glob patterns (relative, forward slashes, ** supported) selecting candidate files. Empty means every supported file.

exclude.description: Glob patterns removing files from the scan. Applied after include.

max_file_size.description: Largest file (bytes) the scanner will read. Bounded to keep memory use predictable.

allowed_domains.description: Hosts scanned content may legitimately reference for network access (exact host, subdomains included, or *.wildcard).

allowed_capabilities.description: Capability names skills may declare in frontmatter (for example "network").

disabled_rules.description: Rule IDs to disable. Disabling every detection rule is rejected.

suppressions.description: Targeted, justified exceptions. Each needs a rule, a non-empty reason, and a path or fingerprint scope.

path.description: Specific workspace-relative file the exception applies to. Wildcards are accepted only when a fingerprint is also present, and patterns that could cover the whole supported file set are rejected by the parser.

fingerprint.description: Finding fingerprint (16 lowercase hex characters) from a JSON/SARIF report.

reason.description: Why this finding is acceptable. Must not be empty.

expires.description: Last valid day (inclusive), YYYY-MM-DD. After it, the suppression stops applying and surfaces as an ASG900 finding.

relativeGlob.description: Relative glob with forward slashes; "..", backslashes, and absolute paths are rejected.
